zh.title: 聯邦快遞發表復古塗裝777F貨機 孟菲斯機場以創辦人命名
zh.summary: 聯邦快遞展示復古777F貨機；孟菲斯機場更名紀念創辦人史密斯
body: 聯邦快遞（FedEx）發表一架採用復古塗裝的波音777F貨機，塗裝靈感源自該公司於1973年成立初期使用的機型。這架貨機亮相之際，位於孟菲斯的樞紐機場也正式更名為弗雷德里克·威廉·史密斯國際機場，以紀念公司創辦人史密斯。
這架國籍標誌登記為N884FD的波音777F貨機命名為「Rosie」，塗裝風格參照了聯邦快遞早期使用的達梭獵鷹20（Dassault Falcon 20）噴射機。聯邦快遞於1973年4月17日在孟菲斯展開營運，最初以14架獵鷹20機隊提供服務。創辦人史密斯於2025年6月21日去世，享壽80歲。

en.title: FedEx Unveils Retro Boeing 777F Livery as Memphis Airport Renamed for Founder
en.summary: FedEx unveils retro Boeing 777F livery in Memphis; airport renamed in honor of founder Fred Smith.
body: FedEx has unveiled a Boeing 777 Freighter featuring a retro livery inspired by the aircraft that launched its operations over 50 years ago. The unveiling coincides with the renaming of Memphis airport to Frederick W. Smith International Airport in honor of the company's founder.

The 777F, registered N884FD and named Rosie, sports a paint scheme based on the Dassault Falcon 20 aircraft used when Federal Express began flights from Memphis on April 17, 1973, with an initial fleet of 14 aircraft. Founder Frederick W. Smith passed away on June 21, 2025, at age 80.

zh.title: 大韓航空與韓亞航空合併案獲董事會及股東會批准
zh.summary: 大韓航空與韓亞航空通過合併案批准；預計12月17日完成登記
body: 大韓航空與韓亞航空於2026年8月12日分別完成董事會與股東會程序，正式批准兩家航空公司之合併案。大韓航空董事會依據韓國商法相關規定通過合併協議，同日韓亞航空於股東臨時會獲得99.3%贊成票通過合併案。
隨着內部批准程序完成，兩家航空公司將推動債權人保護等行政程序。企業合併登記預計於2026年12月17日完成，並計劃於同日正式推出整合後的聯合航空公司。
此前，大韓航空已於2026年6月25日取得韓國國土交通部（MOLIT）之條件式合併批准，並於7月24日通過合併登記聲明審查。目前兩家公司正與相關監管機構協調，進行航空營運許可證（AOC）變更及國際營運許可之申請事宜。

en.title: Korean Air and Asiana Airlines Secure Approvals for December Merger
en.summary: Korean Air and Asiana Airlines secure final approvals ahead of planned December merger.
body: Korean Air and Asiana Airlines have secured formal board and shareholder approvals on August 12, 2026, for their planned merger. Korean Air's board of directors ratified the merger agreement under South Korea's Commercial Act, while Asiana Airlines obtained shareholder approval during an extraordinary general meeting with 99.3% of votes cast in favor.

Following these internal ratifications, both carriers are moving into creditor protection procedures and remaining administrative steps. The final corporate merger registration is scheduled to be completed on December 17, 2026, coinciding with the expected launch date of the combined airline.

Korean Air previously received conditional merger approval from South Korea's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport on June 25, 2026, and clearance of its merger registration statement on July 24, 2026. The airlines are now working through Air Operator Certificate amendments and international operational permits with relevant authorities.
